Sentence (English): I haven't used one in a while, but maybe it's because I'm getting older.

Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. I'm the type of person who feels more comfortable when the dishwasher is washed and placed on the drying rack right away. I haven't used one in a while, but maybe it's because I'm getting older. It took 30-40 minutes to wash the dishes, and my shoulders started to hurt. Seeing my friend just do a quick wash and put the dishes away, I realized I couldn't do it. He was quick and thorough, leaving no waste behind, and checked the drainage and water supply before leaving. Design and Size 3. Size and Design: The Mydia Auto-Open Dishwasher for 6-Persons has a clean color scheme and a sophisticated design that blends well with my kitchen interior. It's the perfect size for a 2-3 person household or a small family, and it takes up just the right amount of space. 4. Functionality: The convenience of the auto-opening feature. Cleaning Performance and Noise: For a 6-person dishwasher, the cleaning power is quite good. It effectively removes not only regular dishes but also grease, ensuring it stays clean even after daily use. However, it's a bit noisy during operation, which can be a bit of a nuisance in quiet environments. Usage Tip: Using the auto-opening feature and leaving the door open immediately after washing helps the interior dry better. The auto-opening feature significantly enhances hygiene and convenience. With its impressive cleaning power and attractive design, this dishwasher is a great choice for anyone looking for a cost-effective option.

Sentence (English): The auto-opening feature significantly enhances hygiene and convenience.

Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. I'm the type of person who feels more comfortable when the dishwasher is washed and placed on the drying rack right away. I haven't used one in a while, but maybe it's because I'm getting older. Size and Design: The Mydia Auto-Open Dishwasher for 6-Persons has a clean color scheme and a sophisticated design that blends well with my kitchen interior. It's the perfect size for a 2-3 person household or a small family, and it takes up just the right amount of space. 4. Functionality: The convenience of the auto-opening feature. Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Because my house is small, I didn't think I could fit a dishwasher. Since we're a two-person household, I even wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary. However, the Mydia 6-person dishwasher can be installed even in tight spaces, so it fits well in my small home. Thanks to this, I'm enjoying a leisurely dessert time after a meal! # Installation: The technician contacted me the morning of the installation and told me the installation time. It was a little inconvenient to only know the installation time that morning, so I asked if I could adjust the time if I did it on a different day. The technician said he knows the installation schedule every morning, so he said it would be difficult to adjust in advance. Still, he did his best to accommodate my schedule, and the installation was quick and friendly. # The perforation holes are approximately 7mm in diameter. *Water supply: Requires a 7mm hole (If there is a hole for the water purifier, it can be used together)*Drainage: Connect the hose and drain the water into the sink # The design is clean and simple. The front is sky blue and the side is white, so it looks pretty like a candy bar color. It looks very clean when I removed the grade sticker. # The automatic door opening function is my favorite function. Once it is turned on, it is very convenient because you don't have to worry about opening the door when it is finished. And the installer told me that it is good to leave the door slightly open even during normal times. # Washing function There are 4 washing cycles, but I use the regular cycle as the basic one. The time is 134 minutes, which is a bit long, so it is good to press it when you go to work and leave. It is perfect because the door opens automatically when it is done anyway. # Size I did the dishes after eating two meals. I put in 2 plates, 2 bowls, 2 cups, 4 Lock & Locks, several spoons, and 1 small pot. It is a little hard to put in a pot or a large plate. It was tricky, but somehow I can fit it in if I play Tetris. I feel better if I think of things like large frying pans as just washing them separately. # Overall Since I have a dishwasher, I can use the cooking utensils with peace of mind when I cook. Since I don't have to wash the dishes after eating, I have a lot more time and peace of mind. It's a bit small because it's for 6 people, but I think it's the best choice for a 2-person household in a small house.

The installer also advised me to leave the door slightly ajar even during normal use. # Washing function. There are four wash cycles, but I use the regular cycle as the default. I put in two plates, two bowls, two cups, four Lock & Locks, several spoons, and one small pot. It's a bit small for six people, but for a two-person household in a small house, it seems like the perfect choice.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. My house is small, so I didn't think a dishwasher would be a necessity. Since we're a two-person household, I even wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary. However, the Mydia 6-person dishwasher fits easily into even the smallest of spaces, making it a perfect fit for our small home. Thanks to this, I'm enjoying a leisurely dessert break after a meal! # Installation. The installer contacted me the morning of the day of the installation and told me the installation time. It was a bit inconvenient to only know the installation time that morning, so I asked if I could adjust the time for another day. The installer said they only know the installation schedule every morning, so it's difficult to adjust in advance. Still, they did their best to accommodate my schedule, and the installation was quick and friendly. # Drill holes are approximately 7mm. *Water supply: Requires a 7mm drill hole. (If your water purifier has a drill hole, you can use it.) *Drain: Connect a hose to drain water into the sink. # Design: Clean and uncluttered. The front is sky blue and the sides are white, so it's as pretty as a candy bar. I removed the rating sticker and it looks very neat. # Automatic door opening. This is my favorite feature. Once you turn it on, you don't have to worry about opening the door when it's finished, which is very convenient. The installer also advised me to leave the door slightly ajar even during normal use. # Washing function. There are four wash cycles, but I use the regular cycle as the default. The 134-minute wash time is a bit long, so I prefer to just press it when I leave for work. The door automatically opens when it's done, which is perfect. # Size. I washed the dishes after two meals. I put in two plates, two bowls, two cups, four Lock & Locks, several spoons, and one small pot. It was a bit tricky to fit the pots and large plates, but I managed to get them all in with a little Tetris. It's nice to think about washing larger items like frying pans separately. # Overall. Now that I have a dishwasher, I can use the kitchen utensils with peace of mind. And since I don't have to do dishes after meals, I have a lot more time and peace of mind. It's a bit small for six people, but for a two-person household in a small house, it seems like the perfect choice.

Sentence (English): But I haven't used one in a while.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Thanks to the automatic door opening, dishwashing has become so much easier! 1. Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. I'm the type of person who feels more comfortable when the dishwasher is washed and placed on the drying rack right away. But I haven't used one in a while. Maybe it's because I'm getting older, but since it takes 30-40 minutes to wash the dishes, my shoulders are starting to hurt. Seeing my friend just do a quick wash, put the dishes away, and then just sit back and relax, I knew I couldn't do it. So I researched and decided on Mydia because I absolutely needed an automatic door opening. The biggest reason was that if I didn't open the door after drying, the heat would stay inside. It would smell. 2. Delivery and installation: The delivery person called me ahead of time, so I was prepared. I was worried because it was raining heavily, but they arrived on time. I read some reviews saying the installer was rude, but they were incredibly kind. I'd like to give the installer a lot of praise! He was quick and thorough, leaving no waste behind, and checked the drainage and water supply before leaving. Design and Size: 3. Size and Design: The Mydia 6-seater automatic door-opening dishwasher has a clean color scheme and sophisticated design that blends well with my kitchen interior. It's the perfect size for a 6-seater household, as well as a small family, and it takes up just the right amount of space. 4. Function: The convenience of the automatic door-opening function: My favorite feature is the automatic door-opening function. After washing, the door automatically opens slightly, allowing moisture to escape, reducing concerns about mold. Since I don't have to open the door manually, it saves me from touching the dishwasher and is more hygienic, which is very satisfying. 5. Cleaning Performance and Noise: For a 6-seater dishwasher, the cleaning power is quite good. It effectively removes not only regular dishes but also grease, so it stays clean even after daily use. However, it's a bit noisy during operation, which can be a bit of a nuisance in quiet environments. Usage Tips: - Utilizing the auto-open function and leaving the door open immediately after washing will help the interior dry better. - The secret to maximizing cleaning performance is to arrange dishes in a way that utilizes the space as efficiently as possible, but does not overcrowd them. - Removing food scraps before washing will improve cleaning performance. This product greatly enhances hygiene and convenience thanks to the auto-open function. It has excellent cleaning performance and a good design, so I recommend it to anyone looking for a cost-effective dishwasher.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Thanks to the automatic door opening, dishwashing has become so much easier! 1. Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. I'm the type of person who feels more comfortable when the dishwasher is washed and placed on the drying rack right away. But I haven't used one in a while. Maybe it's because I'm getting older, but since it takes 30-40 minutes to wash the dishes, my shoulders are starting to hurt. Seeing my friend just do a quick wash, put the dishes away, and then just sit back and relax, I knew I couldn't do it. So I researched and decided on Mydia because I absolutely needed an automatic door opening. The biggest reason was that if I didn't open the door after drying, the heat would stay inside. I read some reviews saying the installer was rude, but they were incredibly kind. I'd like to give the installer a lot of praise! He was quick and thorough, leaving no waste behind, and checked the drainage and water supply before leaving. Design and Size: 3. Size and Design: The Mydia 6-seater automatic door-opening dishwasher has a clean color scheme and sophisticated design that blends well with my kitchen interior. It's the perfect size for a 6-seater household, as well as a small family, and it takes up just the right amount of space. 4. Function: The convenience of the automatic door-opening function: My favorite feature is the automatic door-opening function. Since I don't have to open the door manually, it saves me from touching the dishwasher and is more hygienic, which is very satisfying. 5. Usage Tips: - Utilizing the auto-open function and leaving the door open immediately after washing will help the interior dry better. - The secret to maximizing cleaning performance is to arrange dishes in a way that utilizes the space as efficiently as possible, but does not overcrowd them. - Removing food scraps before washing will improve cleaning performance. It has excellent cleaning performance and a good design, so I recommend it to anyone looking for a cost-effective dishwasher.

Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. Function: The convenience of the automatic door-opening function: My favorite feature is the automatic door-opening function. Sentence (English): Cleaning performance and Noise: For a 6-seater dishwasher, the cleaning power is quite good.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Thanks to the automatic door opening, dishwashing has become so much easier! 1. Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. I'm the type of person who feels more comfortable when the dishwasher is washed and placed on the drying rack right away. But I haven't used one in a while. Maybe it's because I'm getting older, but since it takes 30-40 minutes to wash the dishes, my shoulders are starting to hurt. Seeing my friend just do a quick wash, put the dishes away, and then just sit back and relax, I knew I couldn't do it. So I researched and decided on Mydia because I absolutely needed an automatic door opening. The biggest reason was that if I didn't open the door after drying, the heat would stay inside. He was quick and thorough, leaving no waste behind, and checked the drainage and water supply before leaving. Design and Size: 3. Size and Design: The Mydia 6-seater automatic door-opening dishwasher has a clean color scheme and sophisticated design that blends well with my kitchen interior. It's the perfect size for a 6-seater household, as well as a small family, and it takes up just the right amount of space. 4. Function: The convenience of the automatic door-opening function: My favorite feature is the automatic door-opening function. Usage Tips: - Utilizing the auto-open function and leaving the door open immediately after washing will help the interior dry better. - The secret to maximizing cleaning performance is to arrange dishes in a way that utilizes the space as efficiently as possible, but does not overcrowd them. - Removing food scraps before washing will improve cleaning performance. This product greatly enhances hygiene and convenience thanks to the auto-open function. It has excellent cleaning performance and a good design, so I recommend it to anyone looking for a cost-effective dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The secret to maximizing cleaning performance is to arrange dishes in a way that utilizes the space as efficiently as possible, but does not overcrowd them. -

Function: The convenience of the automatic door-opening function: My favorite feature is the automatic door-opening function. Sentence (English): It has excellent cleaning performance and a good design, so I recommend it to anyone looking for a cost-effective dishwasher.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Thanks to the automatic door opening, dishwashing has become so much easier! 1. Reason for purchase: I haven't used a dishwasher in the 10 years since I got married. I'm the type of person who feels more comfortable when the dishwasher is washed and placed on the drying rack right away. But I haven't used one in a while. Maybe it's because I'm getting older, but since it takes 30-40 minutes to wash the dishes, my shoulders are starting to hurt. Seeing my friend just do a quick wash, put the dishes away, and then just sit back and relax, I knew I couldn't do it. So I researched and decided on Mydia because I absolutely needed an automatic door opening. The biggest reason was that if I didn't open the door after drying, the heat would stay inside. It would smell. 2. Delivery and installation: The delivery person called me ahead of time, so I was prepared. I was worried because it was raining heavily, but they arrived on time. I read some reviews saying the installer was rude, but they were incredibly kind. I'd like to give the installer a lot of praise! He was quick and thorough, leaving no waste behind, and checked the drainage and water supply before leaving. Design and Size: 3. Size and Design: The Mydia 6-seater automatic door-opening dishwasher has a clean color scheme and sophisticated design that blends well with my kitchen interior. It's the perfect size for a 6-seater household, as well as a small family, and it takes up just the right amount of space. 4. Function: The convenience of the automatic door-opening function: My favorite feature is the automatic door-opening function. After washing, the door automatically opens slightly, allowing moisture to escape, reducing concerns about mold. Since I don't have to open the door manually, it saves me from touching the dishwasher and is more hygienic, which is very satisfying. 5. Cleaning Performance and Noise: For a 6-seater dishwasher, the cleaning power is quite good. It effectively removes not only regular dishes but also grease, so it stays clean even after daily use. However, it's a bit noisy during operation, which can be a bit of a nuisance in quiet environments. Usage Tips: - Utilizing the auto-open function and leaving the door open immediately after washing will help the interior dry better. - The secret to maximizing cleaning performance is to arrange dishes in a way that utilizes the space as efficiently as possible, but does not overcrowd them. - Removing food scraps before washing will improve cleaning performance. This product greatly enhances hygiene and convenience thanks to the auto-open function. It has excellent cleaning performance and a good design, so I recommend it to anyone looking for a cost-effective dishwasher.

Sentence (English): It's too early for me to tell the quality of the actual dishwasher, but I would like to rate my experience with this product.
Comments (English): [ VERY disappointed in Costco ] || ---------------- || It's too early for me to tell the quality of the actual dishwasher, but I would like to rate my experience with this product. According to the purchase screen, "Delivery and Installation" are included; however, when the very nice delivery guys brought the dishwasher, they told me installation is not included. So, me being fairly handy around the house, I just asked them to leave the package in the kitchen. After they left, I opened the package to find the dishwasher was damaged. The entire side of the door of the dishwasher was bashed in and dented badly. I went online and was able to report the damaged product, schedule a pickup of the damaged dishwasher, and order a new one. That process went fairly smoothly, although the replacement dishwasher took several more weeks. When the 2nd dishwasher arrived, the driver called me out to the truck to show me that one of the side plates (presumably to protect the dishwasher during transit) was dented inward. He was the same driver as the first time and was extremely nice. I asked if we could take the side plate off to see if the actual dishwasher had been damaged, and it appeared that it had not. I told the driver I would keep the dishwasher, but wanted to reserve the right to return it if it didn't work properly once installed. He agreed and even offered to see if Costco would give me some type of damage credit. I didn't ask for it, but I thought it was a very nice gesture. He called it in and within a few minutes I received a call from a lady at Costco. Now, I'm not sure if my communication needs improvement or whether it's hers, but the call did not go well. She wanted me to agree to accept the damaged item with about a $100 credit back to my card, but it sounded like that would have been the end of everything. I told her I wanted to reserve my right to send the dishwasher back if it didn't work properly once installed, because although it didn't appear to be greatly damaged, I wasn't sure about its internal workings. She then told me to just call back after it was installed. I asked her "Who should I call? You at this 800 number? " She said, "Costco". I said "Who at Costco? " We went back and forth a bit and then she said I should call Costco Logistics. Anyway, confusion ran rampant on the call and I finally just said thanks and hung up. So, I basically spent several minutes trying to figure out how to proceed with getting some type of damage credit that I, in essence, didn't even ask for. I have installed the dishwasher now and have run a couple of cycles, and so far it appears to work okay. However, I'm debating whether it's even worth calling Costco back at this point because this whole situation has disappointed me GREATLY in Costco. (1) No installation when installation was indicated. (2) Significantly damaged first item. (3) Visually damaged second item. (4) Weird back and forth customer service experience. Oh, and one more thing, it now appears the dishwasher I bought is on sale and I could purchase for much cheaper, so any damage discount may or may not even get me to actual market price.

Sentence (English): We purchased 3 kitchen appliances sold by home depot and manufactured by Samsung.
Comments (English): We purchased 3 kitchen appliances sold by home depot and manufactured by Samsung. Paid for installation of this dishwasher, and a refrigerator, and a induction oven. When we made an effort to use the dishwasher. The the LED menus we're in a foreign asian language. We had no Information on how to change that setting. And it was very frustrating because we did not understand any of the symbols that language uses. I did finally figure out how to scroll through the menu based on how many pages are in the online user manual. We did not get a printed user manual with machine. My biggest gripe with the entire purchase procces is actually with samsung customer service. Our purchase decision was driven by incentives samsung promoted to include a two year extension on home service for each of the appliances. Also a new set of cookware for the induction range. And also a fit promise of the new stove offering a one hundred dollar gift card. Good luck to anyone trying to claim any incentives offered by samsung. I exchanged emails with them five times Over the course of a month. and never once received satisfaction for any of the claims.First off the home depot invoice did not list the model numbers of the items that I purchased, That shame goes on the home depot. We then working with the home depot customer service we were able to assemble the products ordered and their model numbers. Then we needed to provide the serial numbers for each of the items. So we had to take photographs and include those in a third submission. And then for the perfect fit samsung required dimension graphics. The Samsung customer service required documentation of a installer invoice to modify the space for the oven. Good luck trying to get that from a tradesman for $100 dollars. My only hope is that the manufacturing quality far exceeds the customer service department at samsung.

Cleaning capability and quiteness 5/5 stars. Drying is fine so long as you use high and leave the stuff in there awhile after the cycle ends. 3rd appliance ordered from Costco and this delivery/install went great like the last ones (near Sacramento, CA). I will likely continue to buy appliances through them.

However, my wife, who majored in mechanical engineering, knew that it was not very clean because she was a former dishwasher developer. However, as a busy working couple, it was difficult to cook, wash dishes, clean, and do laundry right after work, so I wanted to change my life little by little through machines and create some free time for each member. After thinking about it for several years, I bought a dishwasher. 1) Reason for buying a Samsung product. I use a washing machine and dryer, and I bought a Samsung TV. I live with a Biscoff refrigerator and a kimchi refrigerator. I use Samsung air conditioners and Samsung products through the Samsung Think app, so I bought a dishwasher. I am not a Samsung employee, but somehow I changed my home appliances one by one and became a Samsung product family. 2) Delivery and installation. The installation technician contacted me 3-4 days after purchase, and the pre-inspection technician and the installation technician were separate, so I was able to check the possibility of installation in the morning and install the product in the afternoon at once. 3) Product function and usability. The review of the wife who is a mechanical engineering major and product developer is that it is a 12-person size, but it is bigger than expected and there are many dishes displayed, which is good, but since the dishes are washed through the bottom and middle pan, it needs to be washed as cleanly as possible rather than just putting them in. I think the shape of the dishes and the overlapping should be minimized so that they can be washed thoroughly in every corner. I put in 4-person dishes and 3 medium plates, 3 side dish bowls, and various utensils, and it took about an hour to wash. When the washing is complete, the door opens automatically and natural drying begins. In the past, I used to stand for an hour just to wash the dishes, but now I am most satisfied with the fact that I can do other things during that time. In an era that pursues work-life balance, I think it is healthy to live a life of health and small happiness rather than money. I will use it well in the future. ^^. Also, the two installers were so kind and I was so grateful for their cleanliness.

However, my wife, who majored in mechanical engineering, knew that it was not very clean because she was a former dishwasher developer. However, as a busy working couple, it was difficult to cook, wash dishes, clean, and do laundry right after work, so I wanted to change my life little by little through machines and create some free time for each member. After thinking about it for several years, I bought a dishwasher. 1) Reason for buying a Samsung product. I use a washing machine and dryer, and I bought a Samsung TV. I live with a Biscoff refrigerator and a kimchi refrigerator. I use Samsung air conditioners and Samsung products through the Samsung Think app, so I bought a dishwasher. I am not a Samsung employee, but somehow I changed my home appliances one by one and became a Samsung product family. 2) Delivery and installation. The installation technician contacted me 3-4 days after purchase, and the pre-inspection technician and the installation technician were separate, so I was able to check the possibility of installation in the morning and install the product in the afternoon at once. 3) Product function and usability. The review of the wife who is a mechanical engineering major and product developer is that it is a 12-person size, but it is bigger than expected and there are many dishes displayed, which is good, but since the dishes are washed through the bottom and middle pan, it needs to be washed as cleanly as possible rather than just putting them in. I think the shape of the dishes and the overlapping should be minimized so that they can be washed thoroughly in every corner. I put in 4-person dishes and 3 medium plates, 3 side dish bowls, and various utensils, and it took about an hour to wash. When the washing is complete, the door opens automatically and natural drying begins. In the past, I used to stand for an hour just to wash the dishes, but now I am most satisfied with the fact that I can do other things during that time. In an era that pursues work-life balance, I think it is healthy to live a life of health and small happiness rather than money. I will use it well in the future. ^^. Also, the two installers were so kind and I was so grateful for their cleanliness.

Comments (English): [ It was a dishwasher that I had wanted to buy for a long time. However, my wife, who majored in mechanical engineering, knew that it was not very clean because she had previously developed a dishwasher. However, since we are both busy working couples, it was a product that was far from being purchased. ] || ---------------- || I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time. However, my wife, who majored in mechanical engineering, knew that it was not very clean because she was a former dishwasher developer. However, as a busy working couple, it was difficult to cook, wash dishes, clean, and do laundry right after work, so I wanted to change my life little by little through machines and create some free time for each member. After thinking about it for several years, I bought a dishwasher. 1) Reason for buying a Samsung product. I use a washing machine and dryer, and I bought a Samsung TV. I live with a Biscoff refrigerator and a kimchi refrigerator. I use Samsung air conditioners and Samsung products through the Samsung Think app, so I bought a dishwasher. I am not a Samsung employee, but somehow I changed my home appliances one by one and became a Samsung product family. 2) Delivery and installation. The installation technician contacted me 3-4 days after purchase, and the pre-inspection technician and the installation technician were separate, so I was able to check the possibility of installation in the morning and install the product in the afternoon at once. 3) Product function and usability. The review of the wife who is a mechanical engineering major and product developer is that it is a 12-person size, but it is bigger than expected and there are many dishes displayed, which is good, but since the dishes are washed through the bottom and middle pan, it needs to be washed as cleanly as possible rather than just putting them in. I think the shape of the dishes and the overlapping should be minimized so that they can be washed thoroughly in every corner. I put in 4-person dishes and 3 medium plates, 3 side dish bowls, and various utensils, and it took about an hour to wash. When the washing is complete, the door opens automatically and natural drying begins. In the past, I used to stand for an hour just to wash the dishes, but now I am most satisfied with the fact that I can do other things during that time. In an era that pursues work-life balance, I think it is healthy to live a life of health and small happiness rather than money. I will use it well in the future. ^^. Also, the two installers were so kind and I was so grateful for their cleanliness.

I think the shape of the dishes and the overlapping should be minimized so that they can be washed thoroughly in every corner. In an era that pursues work-life balance, I think it is healthy to live a life of health and small happiness rather than money. I will use it well in the future. ^^. Also, the two installers were so kind and I was so grateful for their cleanliness.

However, my wife, who majored in mechanical engineering, knew that it was not very clean because she was a former dishwasher developer. I am not a Samsung employee, but somehow I changed my home appliances one by one and became a Samsung product family. 2) Delivery and installation. The installation technician contacted me 3-4 days after purchase, and the pre-inspection technician and the installation technician were separate, so I was able to check the possibility of installation in the morning and install the product in the afternoon at once. 3) Product function and usability. The review of the wife who is a mechanical engineering major and product developer is that it is a 12-person size, but it is bigger than expected and there are many dishes displayed, which is good, but since the dishes are washed through the bottom and middle pan, it needs to be washed as cleanly as possible rather than just putting them in. I think the shape of the dishes and the overlapping should be minimized so that they can be washed thoroughly in every corner. I put in 4-person dishes and 3 medium plates, 3 side dish bowls, and various utensils, and it took about an hour to wash. When the washing is complete, the door opens automatically and natural drying begins. In the past, I used to stand for an hour just to wash the dishes, but now I am most satisfied with the fact that I can do other things during that time. In an era that pursues work-life balance, I think it is healthy to live a life of health and small happiness rather than money. I will use it well in the future. ^^. Also, the two installers were so kind and I was so grateful for their cleanliness.

I think the shape of the dishes and the overlapping should be minimized so that they can be washed thoroughly in every corner. I put in 4-person dishes and 3 medium plates, 3 side dish bowls, and various utensils, and it took about an hour to wash. When the washing is complete, the door opens automatically and natural drying begins. In the past, I used to stand for an hour just to wash the dishes, but now I am most satisfied with the fact that I can do other things during that time. In an era that pursues work-life balance, I think it is healthy to live a life of health and small happiness rather than money. I will use it well in the future. ^^. Also, the two installers were so kind and I was so grateful for their cleanliness.

Comments (English): [ Good for the money ] || ---------------- || Overall, this is a good, quiet dishwasher that gets the job done.Prior to this model, I owned a Bosch that served us well for 12 years. Occasionally, we hear it switch cycles, but overall, the noise is minimal.Three racks are extremely useful, especially for smaller items.Excellent cleaning performance. Sentence (English): Seems to be a very high quality product for the price point.
Comments (English): [ Very happy with this purchase ] || ---------------- || Seems to be a very high quality product for the price point. This unit has everything I was looking for; smudge proof stainless surface, a 3rd rack (which I find very useful), it is extremely quiet and the dishes come out squeaky clean. Sometimes, we have to check if it is actually running it is so quiet. I also appreciate that it does not have wifi or other bells and whistles that I don't find necessary. I took 1 star off because the instructions did not cover what to do when stabilizing it to a stone counter top. The installation manual says it will explain it further down in the instructions but it never does. So we didn't have what we needed to stabilize it when it was installed. Also, like in some of the reviews I read, the bottom shelf doesn't hold as many plates and bowls as you may want. Not a deal breaker for us because it is still a great and useful dishwasher but it may be an issue for a larger family.

I was somewhat surprised that even though this unit is the same size the interior is somewhat small compared to what i was previously acclimated to. The unit is not that loud compared to what the decibel meter says on the website. I do associate Maytag as that decades old appliance that does not break down, so we shall see. Overall, I have to stick with the 4 stars as the room inside the dishwasher is small. If that problem is solved I would defiantly rate it a 5. The unit works and does what it is supposed to.

Sentence (English): Those who distrust dishwashers, go to a stream and beat your clothes with a paddle.
Comments (English): Those who distrust dishwashers, go to a stream and beat your clothes with a paddle. In a world where washing machines wash clothes, vacuum cleaners and scrubbers handle cleaning, and Minix takes care of food waste, why is it that people uniquely think dishes must be washed by hand? I have been living independently for quite some time now, but when I mentioned buying a dishwasher, my mom was furious, saying she would not tolerate it and would sever our family ties. However, I felt that if I did the dishes one more time, my back would break before our family ties did, so I bought it immediately. You can imagine how much I hated doing the dishes. Sentence (English): Overall, this is a good, quiet dishwasher that gets the job done.
Comments (English): [ Good for the money ] || ---------------- || Overall, this is a good, quiet dishwasher that gets the job done. Prior to this model, I owned a Bosch that served us well for 12 years. I've had the GE Profile dishwasher for several months now, and here are our impressions:. PROS:. It is very quiet. Occasionally, we hear it switch cycles, but overall, the noise is minimal. Three racks are extremely useful, especially for smaller items. Excellent cleaning performance. We've never had to rewash a dish, and we're especially pleased with the steam cycle feature. CONS:. Compared to our former Bosch, more interior parts are plastic. While they don't feel cheap, the difference in materials is noticeable. The buttonless control panel on the door edge can be frustrating. Sometimes it takes multiple presses for a command to register. I wouldn't be surprised if this panel is the first thing to fail over time. Spacing on the bottom rack is too wide for standard dishes. It seems designed with larger pans or pots in mind, but if you're not using those, regular plates and dishes can shift around when moving the rack. Final Thoughts:. While this dishwasher doesn't feel quite as solid or premium as our previous Bosch, it works very well. For us, it's a bit like owning a BMW for years and then switching to a top-of-the-line Chevy—you'll still get where you need to go, but you'll notice the difference in the ride. That said, we're happy with the performance and especially the quiet operation. Overall, it's a good dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I am a Samsung VIP customer for several years.
Comments (English): [ Samsung.com refuses to honor Promotions ] || ---------------- || I am a Samsung VIP customer for several years. For the short time I've owned it, the product appears to be performing adequately. However, I've had multiple interactions with Samsung Customer Support as Samsung refused to honor their commitments on the order. I'm providing details as a warning to others before they order from Samsung. In short, Samsung canceled a multiple-appliances order I placed directly with Samsung, for no apparent reason. I immediately contacted a “Samsung Expert' who re-created the order for me. It was about $200 more than the canceled order. The Expert said he would personally contact me after delivery to ensure I received a price-match to the original order. He also confirmed Samsung would honor promotions for a two-year warranty and a 'bespoke' $100 certificate for a future purchase. However, the 'Expert' did not follow-up after the products were delivered. When I contacted Samsung, they refused to honor the price match to the canceled order. Samsung also refused to honor the two-year warranty and the $100 certificate promo. They refused to let me return the products for a refund. Customer Service denied my repeated requests to talk to a manager. In email, Samsung stated “I completely agree with your points and sincerely apologize for the mistake made by the previous agent. We accept full responsibility for that oversight.” Per Samsung, their Expert was not aware that my Samsung.com account information apparently needed to be updated for a change to the shipping address used on the order. Because the shipping address was not updated, Samsung denied the commitments detailed above. I updated the address on my profile, and Samsung still refused to honor their commitments. Samsung offered no other explanation for refusing to honor their obligations. They repeatedly refused to let me talk to a manager. I sent this review to several of the Samsung 'experts' before posting, and asked they contact me if there were any inaccuracies. They did not respond. When I left a similar review on the two other appliances, Samsung posted replies to my reviews. They provided four contacts and a reference number. I reached out to two of the four, and they had no idea what the references were. I tried customer service on my own again. The Samsung Expert thought they may be a warranty reference, and suggested I contact the warranty department. Another runaround. Please use caution if you deal directly with Samsung!

Sentence (English): Bottom line is that the dishwasher doesn't clean the dishes.
Comments (English): [ $600 to Hand Wash Your Dishes Again. What Good is a Dishwasher That Doesn't Wash? ] || ---------------- || Bottom line is that the dishwasher doesn't clean the dishes. Period. Brand new - tried three loads over one week, and all left at least 50% or more of the dishes with crusty things or worse on them. The load we did last night left 20 of 25 items dirty to some degree with 5 of them downright terrible. Honestly, I expect 100% clean! How can appliances this expensive be this poor? For that matter, how can ANY machine that's supposed to do something - at any price - not do the one thing it's supposed to do? We tried the "Auto" setting the 2nd and 3rd loads and I think something "standard" (or whatever it's called) the first time. This last load we chose "economy" as well to see what that would do. Nothing better or worse. Even the seemingly clean dishes have a little white haze on them. Basic, white Ikea dishes: glazed, very smooth finish that should be the easiest thing to get clean. Nothing was what I would call "heavily soiled." We rinsed the first load, but then did NOT rinse the other loads, just scraping the big particles off - just like the owners manual says to do. We used rinse aid, Cascade detergent, etc. Hopefully LG won't suggest using other cycles. Even if that works, that means they are admitting that they are putting a bunch of bogus cycles on their machines, which undoubtedly raises the price, when the customer can't actually use those cycles.Trying to sort out the choice of appliances - all of which have stellar and horrid reviews is enough to just go back to hand washing everything. Even the expensive brands have some terrible reviews, so what to do? So we now begin the road to get customer service. Let's see what that's like.

Sentence (English): I really wanted to like this dish washer.
Comments (English): [ Dishes dont get clean and wont dry. ] || ---------------- || I really wanted to like this dish washer. Its fits so much more than our old one. Its quiet, its sleek…. But its absolutely useless. It doesnt get the dishes very clean and it doesnt dry them at all. We replaced a dishwasher from 1983 that was loud but still worked. This was a total waste of money. Most of my dishes are wet after each wash and some are still dirty. We dont even put dishes in that dirty. I followed all the troubleshooting and still have the same issues. This washer doesn't have a heated dry cycle and says that it relies on condensation. It “dries” the dishes by using a hot rinse and just hoping the water falls off. It 100% does not work. I would not recommend this thing at all, especially because its twice as expensive as most of the other dishwashers this size.

Comments (English): [ Very happy with this purchase ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) Seems to be a very high quality product for the price point. This unit has everything I was looking for; smudge proof stainless surface, a 3rd rack (which I find very useful), it is extremely quiet and the dishes come out squeaky clean. Sometimes, we have to check if it is actually running it is so quiet. I also appreciate that it does not have wifi or other bells and whistles that I don't find necessary. I took 1 star off because the instructions did not cover what to do when stabilizing it to a stone counter top. The installation manual says it will explain it further down in the instructions but it never does. So we didn't have what we needed to stabilize it when it was installed. Also, like in some of the reviews I read, the bottom shelf doesn't hold as many plates and bowls as you may want. Not a deal breaker for us because it is still a great and useful dishwasher but it may be an issue for a larger family.

Comments (English): [ A must-have item for newlyweds' kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person for about two weeks now, and I'm incredibly satisfied! My kitchen is small, and plumbing is difficult to find, so I've been hesitant about installing a dishwasher, but this one is perfect because it's completely self-installing and requires no drilling. Simply fill the water tank and it's ready to go, saving you space and eliminating the need for a separate installer. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. It only takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and the high-temperature drying process is incredibly reliable, even for baby bottles, baby dishes, and cooking utensils. The basic cleaning power is also excellent. True to its name, the Tornado Water Flow thoroughly washes every nook and cranny of the dishwasher, leaving no blind spots. Even stuck-on rice from soup bowls and greasy dishes are left sparkling clean after each wash. It's much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. Another great feature of this product is its two-tiered tray design. Previous single-tier models were limited in space, but the Minix's two-tier design allows for more dishes, cups, and utensils, resulting in a significant amount of laundry to be washed at once. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. The powerful wash, in particular, reaches a high temperature of 70 degrees Celsius, effectively removing even the most stubborn stains. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. My home has a wood-toned interior, so I chose the oatmeal beige color, and it blends in perfectly. I'm satisfied with the way it creates a fresh and clean feeling in a corner of the kitchen. And another thing, it is even more reassuring that free A/S is provided for up to 2 years. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Lastly, the MINIX-exclusive 3-in-1 tablet detergent is provided separately, so the cleaning power is even more reliable, and the machine has an internal cleaning mode, so maintenance is not difficult. Overall Review: The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is easy to install, has excellent cleaning power, and even has a perfect drying function. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Comments (English): [ A must-have item for newlyweds' kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person for about two weeks now, and I'm incredibly satisfied! My kitchen is small, and plumbing is difficult to find, so I've been hesitant about installing a dishwasher, but this one is perfect because it's completely self-installing and requires no drilling. Simply fill the water tank and it's ready to go, saving you space and eliminating the need for a separate installer. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. It only takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and the high-temperature drying process is incredibly reliable, even for baby bottles, baby dishes, and cooking utensils. The basic cleaning power is also excellent. True to its name, the Tornado Water Flow thoroughly washes every nook and cranny of the dishwasher, leaving no blind spots. Even stuck-on rice from soup bowls and greasy dishes are left sparkling clean after each wash. It's much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. Another great feature of this product is its two-tiered tray design. Previous single-tier models were limited in space, but the Minix's two-tier design allows for more dishes, cups, and utensils, resulting in a significant amount of laundry to be washed at once. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. The powerful wash, in particular, reaches a high temperature of 70 degrees Celsius, effectively removing even the most stubborn stains. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. My home has a wood-toned interior, so I chose the oatmeal beige color, and it blends in perfectly. I'm satisfied with the way it creates a fresh and clean feeling in a corner of the kitchen. And another thing, it is even more reassuring that free A/S is provided for up to 2 years. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Lastly, the MINIX-exclusive 3-in-1 tablet detergent is provided separately, so the cleaning power is even more reliable, and the machine has an internal cleaning mode, so maintenance is not difficult. Overall Review: The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is easy to install, has excellent cleaning power, and even has a perfect drying function. This product is perfect for those with small kitchen spaces or those who are considering installation. MINIX has a minimalist design, various washing cycles, and colors that complement the interior! I sincerely recommend it to those who, like me, want to escape the stress of washing dishes by hand.

Comments (English): [ A must-have item for newlyweds' kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person for about two weeks now, and I'm incredibly satisfied! My kitchen is small, and plumbing is difficult to find, so I've been hesitant about installing a dishwasher, but this one is perfect because it's completely self-installing and requires no drilling. Simply fill the water tank and it's ready to go, saving you space and eliminating the need for a separate installer. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. It only takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and the high-temperature drying process is incredibly reliable, even for baby bottles, baby dishes, and cooking utensils. The basic cleaning power is also excellent. True to its name, the Tornado Water Flow thoroughly washes every nook and cranny of the dishwasher, leaving no blind spots. Even stuck-on rice from soup bowls and greasy dishes are left sparkling clean after each wash. It's much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. Another great feature of this product is its two-tiered tray design. Previous single-tier models were limited in space, but the Minix's two-tier design allows for more dishes, cups, and utensils, resulting in a significant amount of laundry to be washed at once. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. The powerful wash, in particular, reaches a high temperature of 70 degrees Celsius, effectively removing even the most stubborn stains. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. My home has a wood-toned interior, so I chose the oatmeal beige color, and it blends in perfectly. I'm satisfied with the way it creates a fresh and clean feeling in a corner of the kitchen. And another thing, it is even more reassuring that free A/S is provided for up to 2 years. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Lastly, the MINIX-exclusive 3-in-1 tablet detergent is provided separately, so the cleaning power is even more reliable, and the machine has an internal cleaning mode, so maintenance is not difficult. Overall Review: The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is easy to install, has excellent cleaning power, and even has a perfect drying function. This product is perfect for those with small kitchen spaces or those who are considering installation. MINIX has a minimalist design, various washing cycles, and colors that complement the interior! I sincerely recommend it to those who, like me, want to escape the stress of washing dishes by hand.

Comments (English): [ A must-have item for newlyweds' kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person for about two weeks now, and I'm incredibly satisfied! My kitchen is small, and plumbing is difficult to find, so I've been hesitant about installing a dishwasher, but this one is perfect because it's completely self-installing and requires no drilling. Simply fill the water tank and it's ready to go, saving you space and eliminating the need for a separate installer. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. It only takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and the high-temperature drying process is incredibly reliable, even for baby bottles, baby dishes, and cooking utensils. The basic cleaning power is also excellent. True to its name, the Tornado Water Flow thoroughly washes every nook and cranny of the dishwasher, leaving no blind spots. Even stuck-on rice from soup bowls and greasy dishes are left sparkling clean after each wash. It's much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. Another great feature of this product is its two-tiered tray design. Previous single-tier models were limited in space, but the Minix's two-tier design allows for more dishes, cups, and utensils, resulting in a significant amount of laundry to be washed at once. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. The powerful wash, in particular, reaches a high temperature of 70 degrees Celsius, effectively removing even the most stubborn stains. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. My home has a wood-toned interior, so I chose the oatmeal beige color, and it blends in perfectly. I'm satisfied with the way it creates a fresh and clean feeling in a corner of the kitchen. And another thing, it is even more reassuring that free A/S is provided for up to 2 years. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Lastly, the MINIX-exclusive 3-in-1 tablet detergent is provided separately, so the cleaning power is even more reliable, and the machine has an internal cleaning mode, so maintenance is not difficult. Overall Review: The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is easy to install, has excellent cleaning power, and even has a perfect drying function. This product is perfect for those with small kitchen spaces or those who are considering installation. MINIX has a minimalist design, various washing cycles, and colors that complement the interior! I sincerely recommend it to those who, like me, want to escape the stress of washing dishes by hand.

Comments (English): [ A must-have item for newlyweds' kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person for about two weeks now, and I'm incredibly satisfied! My kitchen is small, and plumbing is difficult to find, so I've been hesitant about installing a dishwasher, but this one is perfect because it's completely self-installing and requires no drilling. Simply fill the water tank and it's ready to go, saving you space and eliminating the need for a separate installer. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. It only takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and the high-temperature drying process is incredibly reliable, even for baby bottles, baby dishes, and cooking utensils. The basic cleaning power is also excellent. True to its name, the Tornado Water Flow thoroughly washes every nook and cranny of the dishwasher, leaving no blind spots. Even stuck-on rice from soup bowls and greasy dishes are left sparkling clean after each wash. It's much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. Another great feature of this product is its two-tiered tray design. Previous single-tier models were limited in space, but the Minix's two-tier design allows for more dishes, cups, and utensils, resulting in a significant amount of laundry to be washed at once. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. The powerful wash, in particular, reaches a high temperature of 70 degrees Celsius, effectively removing even the most stubborn stains. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. My home has a wood-toned interior, so I chose the oatmeal beige color, and it blends in perfectly. I'm satisfied with the way it creates a fresh and clean feeling in a corner of the kitchen. And another thing, it is even more reassuring that free A/S is provided for up to 2 years. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Lastly, the MINIX-exclusive 3-in-1 tablet detergent is provided separately, so the cleaning power is even more reliable, and the machine has an internal cleaning mode, so maintenance is not difficult. Overall Review: The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is easy to install, has excellent cleaning power, and even has a perfect drying function. This product is perfect for those with small kitchen spaces or those who are considering installation. MINIX has a minimalist design, various washing cycles, and colors that complement the interior! I sincerely recommend it to those who, like me, want to escape the stress of washing dishes by hand.

I've been using the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person for about two weeks now, and I'm incredibly satisfied! Simply fill the water tank and it's ready to go, saving you space and eliminating the need for a separate installer. This model also features a 55°C (135°F) dry function, ensuring perfect drying without any residual moisture or stickiness. It only takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and the high-temperature drying process is incredibly reliable, even for baby bottles, baby dishes, and cooking utensils. The basic cleaning power is also excellent. True to its name, the Tornado Water Flow thoroughly washes every nook and cranny of the dishwasher, leaving no blind spots. Thanks to this, I only need to do a simple pre-wash before putting the dishes back in, and there are no water stains or food residue left, which is a stress-free experience. Another great feature of this product is its two-tiered tray design. Previous single-tier models were limited in space, but the Minix's two-tier design allows for more dishes, cups, and utensils, resulting in a significant amount of laundry to be washed at once. It's perfect for one- or two-person households, and even three-person families. It also offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to customize your experience. Choose from standard, powerful, quick, interior wash, drying, locking, and storage options. The powerful wash, in particular, reaches a high temperature of 70 degrees Celsius, effectively removing even the most stubborn stains. I mostly use the powerful wash mode, and occasionally use the quick mode to quickly clean up oily dishes. The design is also very attractive. My home has a wood-toned interior, so I chose the oatmeal beige color, and it blends in perfectly. I'm satisfied with the way it creates a fresh and clean feeling in a corner of the kitchen. And another thing, it is even more reassuring that free A/S is provided for up to 2 years. Electronic products are always worried about malfunctions or problems, but since you can use them with confidence because you can receive a 2-year quality warranty simply by authenticating the product. Lastly, the MINIX-exclusive 3-in-1 tablet detergent is provided separately, so the cleaning power is even more reliable, and the machine has an internal cleaning mode, so maintenance is not difficult. Overall Review: The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is easy to install, has excellent cleaning power, and even has a perfect drying function. This product is perfect for those with small kitchen spaces or those who are considering installation. MINIX has a minimalist design, various washing cycles, and colors that complement the interior! I sincerely recommend it to those who, like me, want to escape the stress of washing dishes by hand.

The free A/S free A/S period is 2 years. They say that they provide a free quality warranty service for up to 2 years when you register for genuine product authentication. Many products break down after about a year of use, but 2 years is less of a worry. The gray color is pretty. You can choose from charcoal gray and oatmeal beige. Even though it's mini, it's bigger than you think, so it makes the space you put it in look like interior design. I bought the black one, and it goes well with the white interior because it's a point. The matte color is even prettier. I like the dishes to be squeaky clean, but they're not as squeaky clean as I thought. They dried well, but they felt a little slippery. I need to check if this is a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher. Even if that works, that means they are admitting that they are putting a bunch of bogus cycles on their machines, which undoubtedly raises the price, when the customer can't actually use those cycles. Sentence (English): We needed a new dishwasher, and it had to be Bosch - regardless of hearing over and over that nobody in Cheyenne will work on the brand.
Comments (English): [ This! ] || ---------------- || We needed a new dishwasher, and it had to be Bosch - regardless of hearing over and over that nobody in Cheyenne will work on the brand. We have had a Bosch dishwasher in the past, in another place, and we are comfortable taking the chance, since we don't think it will ever need repair. Anyway, this is not the top of the line, but it has everything we need and more. It is nice and quiet. It has the third rack at the top, and by putting flatware and small items there, it is amazing how much will fit in the other two racks. The machine cleans well without leaving cloudy glasses. The red light at the floor is handy for knowing whether it is running or not (because it is so quiet). There are plenty of cycle options (really more than we use). The only thing that isn't wonderful is the user manual, which generally has the necessary information but is not easy to navigate. Definitely recommend this appliance.

Sentence (English): I bought a new dishwasher because it broke after using it for over 10 years, but this product takes too long.
Comments (English): [ Maybe because it has the highest energy efficiency rating, the performance is much better than what I was using before. ] || ---------------- || I bought a new dishwasher because it broke after using it for over 10 years, but this product takes too long. If you run it for just 1 hour, you can see that it doesn't dry at all. The one I used before (old Dongyang) was basically washed in water over 70 degrees and dried with the door open, so if I added 2 rinses and ran it for 1 hour and 5 minutes, it was very hot and dried as soon as I opened the door (I had to open it), but this one knows that it rinses with lukewarm water and the door opens automatically, but it doesn't dry. Hot air drying is an option, but it's essential to run it, so if you add a rinse and add 40 minutes of hot air, it takes 2 hours. Even if you add 40 minutes of hot air, it doesn't dry completely. It's a grade 1, so it consumes less electricity than the previous product, but it takes a long time to dry the dishes completely, which is inconvenient. While the door is open and the hot air comes out to dry, warm air keeps coming out in the kitchen. Washing the dishes feels too long. I clean the larvae and use it as if I'm disinfecting them briefly, and then organize the dishes in the cabinet. I use it that night and go to bed, but this product should be left in until the morning. Since there is water left and it doesn't dry well, it's difficult to run it several times a day. I often run it twice, but I think I should have just bought one that doesn't have a grade and washes at 70 degrees or higher. I read the product manual carefully before buying it, but I didn't even think that drying wasn't included in the basic operation. You can think about it by adding 40 minutes, 60 minutes, or 90 minutes of hot air to the times in the manual. Sentence (English): I chose a model without a hot air drying function to match the color of the lower cabinet in the kitchen.
Comments (English): I chose a model without a hot air drying function to match the color of the lower cabinet in the kitchen. I really like the appearance. It is clean and simple, and it matches well with the interior, so the kitchen atmosphere feels neat. However, when I actually used it, I was a little disappointed in the drying performance. Since it only has a high-temperature drying method without a hot air drying method, there was more moisture left on the dishes than I thought when I opened the door right after washing. In particular, the spoon and chopstick tray on the top is structurally less likely to drain water, so it was often damp even after half a day. So I ended up wiping the moisture off and putting it back in. This part was a little disappointing because it was far from the convenience of the automatic drying function that I had initially expected. They say that drying performance improves when you use rinse aid, but it’s a little too much for dishes. However, it is quite practical that there is a separate space for knives and scissors. Since you can wash frequently used tools separately, it is hygienic and easy to take them out. The tray is also well divided into three levels, so you can store large dishes or pots in the space you want. The washing power itself is satisfactory. Even greasy dishes are washed cleanly, and there is almost no food residue left, so it passes the mark in terms of washing function alone. However, if you expect perfect drying, it would be a good idea to consider a hot air drying model. Oh! They say that it dries better if you leave the door slightly open after high-temperature drying rather than opening it wide.

Sentence (English): I hadn't been looking to replace our 16 year old Maytag but the electric panel stopped working so we needed to.
Comments (English): [ Do not love ] || ---------------- || I hadn't been looking to replace our 16 year old Maytag but the electric panel stopped working so we needed to. I ordered this GE dishwasher to match the GE oven we purchased last year. I am not happy with the cheap plastic interior and front handle. I do not like the set up of the interior; the prongs feel like there was no thought put into their placement with too much space for plate slots and not enough for bowls to fit all the way in. Also, the front rack corners are cut off (no 90 degree angle) so you lose the corner spaces. The top rack spaces are some wide that smaller items can fall through. Lower rack does not slide easily and gets stuck every time we need to slide it in. Admittedly, i chose the least expensive model, and there wasn't one in stock so I didn't see it in person. Regretting this purchase and wishing I had either bumped up in price range or gone with another brand. It's noisier than my 16 year one was. Cycles seem long at 3 hours with the additional drying time. Sure don't make appliances like they used to, and I'm only 48.

The minimalist cream white exterior creates a clean impression. It blends well into any kitchen interior without any glossy finishes or excessive accents. The display and buttons are clean and uncluttered, making it perfect for those who appreciate a simple aesthetic. Personally, I was most satisfied with how it blends into my kitchen like a decorative piece. Space-efficient (size). Even though my kitchen is quite small for a two-person household, installation was easy. The product itself is mini, requiring only a small space—about three handspans wide and two hands long—for installation. I installed it on one side of the sink in my 800-square-foot (25-pyeong) apartment, and all I had to do was gently extend the drain hose toward the sink. Installation was easy, and the weight was light, so I was able to do it myself. Another great feature is that it can be used without a water connection, drawing water from its own 5.7L water tank. It's suitable for rentals, studio apartments, and officetels. Low noise. My biggest concern before using it was noise, but it was actually quieter than a washing machine. The water circulating is faint, but not so loud that it's annoying, and even when the door automatically opens during use, it's quiet. I'm quite sensitive to noise, but it didn't interfere with my daily life, and I was able to leave it running at night without any problems. However, it's not completely silent, so if you want a completely quiet environment, I recommend using the reservation function. Reasonable price. Considering the design, performance, and ease of installation, I'm quite satisfied with the price. It offers excellent cleaning power, high-temperature sterilization, automatic door opening, and various cleaning modes, making it a great value for the price. The need to purchase a separate detergent was a bit of a disappointment, but the single-tablet system keeps maintenance costs low. Overall, I'm very satisfied with this product, with its compact design, no-hole installation, stylish design, and ease of use. It's versatile enough for a variety of situations, from sterilizing baby bottles to washing pet dishes. With the two-tier tray, it can accommodate most items except large plates and pots. While the noise and water refilling may be a bit of a hassle, the overall benefits far outweigh the inconvenience. Sentence (English): I chose a model without a hot air dryer to match the color of my kitchen cabinets.
Comments (English): I chose a model without a hot air dryer to match the color of my kitchen cabinets. I really like the look. It's clean and uncluttered, blending well with my interior, and it creates a neat and tidy kitchen atmosphere. However, in actual use, I was a little disappointed with the drying performance. Since it only has a high-temperature dryer, not a hot air dryer, there was more moisture left on the dishes than I expected when I opened the door right after washing. The spoon and chopstick trays on top, in particular, are structurally less drainable, so they often remain damp even after half a day. So I ended up having to wipe them dry. This was a bit disappointing, as it didn't quite live up to my initial expectations of the automatic drying function. I heard that using conditioner improves drying performance, but it's a bit of a stretch for dishes. Still, having a separate space for knives and scissors is quite practical. Being able to wash frequently used utensils separately makes them hygienic and easy to access. The tray is neatly divided into three tiers, allowing for easy storage of large dishes and pots. The cleaning performance itself is satisfactory. Even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly, and there's virtually no food residue, making it a perfect choice for cleaning. However, if you're looking for perfect drying, you might want to consider a hot air dryer model. Oh, and they say leaving the door slightly ajar after high-temperature drying helps dry it better.

Sentence (English): After saying goodbye to our Miele, which lasted 20 years, we took the plunge and wanted to try a fresh new brand.
Comments (English): After saying goodbye to our Miele, which lasted 20 years, we took the plunge and wanted to try a fresh new brand. The Haier had all the features we wanted for a much lower price. The door opens automatically at the end of each cycle to finish off the drying process. I can't emphasise too much how this makes a huge difference. Even plastics come out dry! We don't want to use the most aggressive dishwashing tablet because they wreck your ceramic. We use a milder more environmentally friendly one and still everything comes out clean. It always helps to scrape or rinse off the stuff. So this dishwasher cleans very well too. On top of this it has a steam feature which you can add to the cycle to extra clean. This works well too. We installed it ourselves. This was not more difficult than the Miele. Only do this when you are handy. I love this dishwasher. It was definitely worth it to take the plunge!

Sentence (English): I used my dishwasher for over 10 years and bought a new one because it broke down, but the time on this model is way too long.
Comments (English): [ It takes longer than the one I used before, so it is inconvenient. ] || ---------------- || I used my dishwasher for over 10 years and bought a new one because it broke down, but the time on this model is way too long. If I run it for just one hour, you can consider it as not drying at all. The one I used before (an old Dongyang) washed with water over 70 degrees Celsius by default and dried without opening the door, so if I added two rinse cycles and ran it for just 1 hour and 5 minutes, the clothes would be completely dry as soon as I opened the door (which I had to do myself) while they were still extremely hot. However, this one seems to rinse with lukewarm water, so the door opens automatically, but the clothes don't dry. Hot air drying is optional, but it is essential to use it. If you add a rinse and 40 minutes of hot air, you should allow at least two hours. Even with the extra 40 minutes of hot air, the dishes don't dry completely. Since it is a Grade 1 model, it probably consumes less electricity than the previous one, but it is inconvenient because it takes a long time to dry the dishes thoroughly. The door opens and the hot air comes out, so warm air keeps coming out of the kitchen while it dries. Washing dishes feels like such a long time. I am the type of person who finishes organizing the dishes in the cabinet the night before going to bed, but with this product, I have to leave them in until morning because water remains. Also, since they don't dry well, running it multiple times a day is too much. There are many days when I run it twice. Maybe I should have just bought a model without a grade that washes at over 70 degrees. I read the manual carefully before buying it, but I didn't even realize that drying wasn't included in the basic operation. You should estimate the time by adding 40, 60, or 90 minutes of hot air to the times listed in the manual. If you add the optional rinse twice and 40 minutes of hot air to a one-hour cycle, it takes 2 hours and 9 minutes. If I use the 1-hour option with 2 rinses and 40 minutes of steam/hot air, it takes 2 hours and 54 minutes, but there is still moisture remaining. If I leave it until morning, it is gone.
