Comments (English): [ It takes longer than the one I used before, so it is inconvenient. ] || ---------------- || I used my dishwasher for over 10 years and bought a new one because it broke down, but the time on this model is way too long. If I run it for just one hour, you can consider it as not drying at all. The one I used before (an old Dongyang) washed with water over 70 degrees Celsius by default and dried without opening the door, so if I added two rinse cycles and ran it for just 1 hour and 5 minutes, the clothes would be completely dry as soon as I opened the door (which I had to do myself) while they were still extremely hot. However, this one seems to rinse with lukewarm water, so the door opens automatically, but the clothes don't dry. Hot air drying is optional, but it is essential to use it. If you add a rinse and 40 minutes of hot air, you should allow at least two hours. Even with the extra 40 minutes of hot air, the dishes don't dry completely. Since it is a Grade 1 model, it probably consumes less electricity than the previous one, but it is inconvenient because it takes a long time to dry the dishes thoroughly. The door opens and the hot air comes out, so warm air keeps coming out of the kitchen while it dries. Washing dishes feels like such a long time. I am the type of person who finishes organizing the dishes in the cabinet the night before going to bed, but with this product, I have to leave them in until morning because water remains. Sentence (English): The product came in good shape, including free delivery promotion to my house.
Comments (English): The product came in good shape, including free delivery promotion to my house. They brought it inside but were not engaged to set it up. I took out the old one, and installed this one. Initially it would not take on water, and would produce an error code. The valve was sticking and only letting a small amount through (pressure is very good in the line). I called LG Support who was worthless. They kept focusing on the drain connection, not the failure to take on water. From the chat, I suspect the support folks are not in the US. I had an experienced mechanic friend come over, and he took the pump out, banged on it a bit to loosen up whatever was stuck and then after a couple of tries of that process, it started taking on water properly, washing well, and there have been no further issues in 60 days. 1 star off for a stuck fill valve and worthless support. It's also advertised as WIFI capable, but it's not, though hard to find that their app does not talk to it. You can find many references to this in Reddit. It is surprisingly VERY quiet, have to stand next to it to hear it run. They advertise one that is quieter for quite a bit more, but I'm very happy with the choice. The one I took out was extremely quiet too so I was used to not hearing it humming in the background (open kitchen to living room).

It seems like the worst design possible.  Lastly, it is not noisy but for a product that makes such a big deal about being so quiet it is nothing special.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. In the past, dishwashers were often bulky and unwieldy for single-person households. Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  과거에는 식세기라고 하면 굉장히 커서 1인 가구에 사용하기에는 부담스러웠을 겁니다. 아마 신혼 부부들도 그렇고 요즘에는 1-2인 가정이 많아지는 만큼 미닉스에서 새로나온 미니세척기 프로는 요즘 시대를 잘 반영해서 나온 제품이지 않을 싸 해요. 저 역시 1인 가구 인 만큼 3룸이지만, 주방이 그렇게 크지 않은제 미닉스 미니세척기의 경우 이 좁은 공간에서도 쉽게 설치가 가능한 제품이더라구요. 게다가, 제품 자체가 우리가 항상 식세기라고 생각하면 배수관과 직수관이 필수로 설치되어있어야 한다는 사고관념을 깬 제품이지 않을 까 해요. 제품에 하부에 물탱크가 추가로 장착되어있어, 저처럼 직수관을 설치하기 곤란한 유저라면 언제든지 하단에 물을 공급해서 사용할 수 있는 획기적인 제품이지 않을 까 해요 . 제품은 컴팩트해서 원룸에서는 두기에는 조금 힘들지만 저처럼 2룸 이상의 주방에서는 사용이 가능한 크기에요. 색상도 제가 선택한 그레이톤 외에도 밝은 색상의 아이보리 색상도 있어 자신의 주방 인테리어에 선택해서 사용이 가능하구요. 게다가, 사용설명서를 통해 자세히 설치방법이 나뉘어져 있어, 누구나 쉽게 설치가 가능하더라구요. 특히, 직수관을 설치하는 방법과 하단 물탱크를 통해 물을 공급하는 방법이 자세히 그림으로 설명되어있어 누구나 쉽게 바로 설치가 가능했구요. 제품은 한 번 돌리면 대략 6L 정도 소비되는데 자가급수형인 만큼 대용량 컵을 제공해 줘 쉽게 물을 보충해 줄 수 있더라구요. 게다가, 1인가구인 저로썬 하루 몰아서 한 번에 돌리면 될 정도라서 한 번만 채워도 그냥 하루 컷 모든 설거지가 가능하더라구요. 세척 방법도 표준은 물론, 강력과 절약 그리고 쾌속모드가 있어 내가 세척하고자 하는 그릇들이 얼마나 지저분한지에 따라 선택이 가능하게 한 다양성도 너무 칭찬하고 싶어지네요. 게다가, 전면 디스플레이 역시 직관적이고 남은 시간도 모두 표기되는 만큼 멀리서도 남은 시간을 확인할 수 있겠드라구요. 물급수도 쉽고, 요즘은 전용 식세기 세제큐브가 나와 그대로 넣어주면 알아서 세척해주고 있어 굉장히 편리한 세상이더라구요. 가장 중요한 건 세척력인 만큼, 표준으로 돌려보고 사용해본 결과 너무 만족스럽더라구요. 제가 일부러 하루 동안 먹은 것 중 짜장이 찌든것도 넣어보고 별걸 다 넣어봤는데, 그냥 뽀드득 소리가 날 정도로 굉장히 만족스럽게 세척이 되드라구요. 구석에 어디 하나 잔여물이 남지 않고 완벽하게 청소된 모습을 확인할 수 있었을 뿐만 아니라, 찌든 음식물 찌꺼기도 완벽하게 제거해 주더라구요. 세척이 덜 되었다 생각되는 유저라면 언제든지 강력모드로 전환해서 사용하시면 되구요. 세척 시간 역시 엄청 길지 않고, 알아서 세척 후 건조까지 해주는 만큼 더욱 뽀드득한 식기류를 경험할 수 있을 겁니다. 제품은 완벽 건조될 만큼 은 아니고 적당히 윤기 날 정도만 물기가 남고, 나머지는 마른 행주로 닦아주고 마무리 해주면 완벽 그 자체더라구요. 아 그리고 제품을 돌려보고 느꼈지만, 소음부분이 가장 인상적이었어요. 실제로 돌려보면서 34dB 정도가 맥시멈으로 나오면서 거의 정숙형 그 자체라 다른 일 하면서 제품을 사용해도 부담 전혀 없었구요. 영상을 보거나 독서를 함에 있어서도 전혀 부담이 없는 제품이지 않을 까 합니다. 최근 2인 가구 그리고 저처럼 1인가구가 많아지고 있는 시대인 만큼 이렇게 식세기가 컴팩트하게 나옴은 물론, 직수관 필요없이 하단 물탱크에 보충하는 방식은 신박하면서 많은 이들이 쉽게 접할 수 있게 해준 신세계 제품이지 않을 까 해요. 정리하자면 1. 제품은 색상도 오브제 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다.  10. 식세기 내부 세척 모드가 있어, 더욱 위생적인 관리 및 사용이 가능하다.

수 있을 겁니다. 제품은 완벽 건조될 만큼 은 아니고 적당히 윤기 날 정도만 물기가 남고, 나머지는 마른 행주로 닦아주고 마무리 해주면 완벽 그 자체더라구요. 아 그리고 제품을 돌려보고 느꼈지만, 소음부분이 가장 인상적이었어요. 실제로 돌려보면서 34dB 정도가 맥시멈으로 나오면서 거의 정숙형 그 자체라 다른 일 하면서 제품을 사용해도 부담 전혀 없었구요. 영상을 보거나 독서를 함에 있어서도 전혀 부담이 없는 제품이지 않을 까 합니다. 최근 2인 가구 그리고 저처럼 1인가구가 많아지고 있는 시대인 만큼 이렇게 식세기가 컴팩트하게 나옴은 물론, 직수관 필요없이 하단 물탱크에 보충하는 방식은 신박하면서 많은 이들이 쉽게 접할 수 있게 해준 신세계 제품이지 않을 까 해요. 정리하자면 1. 제품은 색상도 오브제 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다.  10. 식세기 내부 세척 모드가 있어, 더욱 위생적인 관리 및 사용이 가능하다.

Sentence (English): Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. In the past, dishwashers were often bulky and unwieldy for single-person households. Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다.  10. 식세기 내부 세척 모드가 있어, 더욱 위생적인 관리 및 사용이 가능하다.

If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. 수 있을 겁니다. 제품은 완벽 건조될 만큼 은 아니고 적당히 윤기 날 정도만 물기가 남고, 나머지는 마른 행주로 닦아주고 마무리 해주면 완벽 그 자체더라구요. 아 그리고 제품을 돌려보고 느꼈지만, 소음부분이 가장 인상적이었어요. 실제로 돌려보면서 34dB 정도가 맥시멈으로 나오면서 거의 정숙형 그 자체라 다른 일 하면서 제품을 사용해도 부담 전혀 없었구요. 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다. Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. In the past, dishwashers were often bulky and unwieldy for single-person households. Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

확인할 수 있겠드라구요. 물급수도 쉽고, 요즘은 전용 식세기 세제큐브가 나와 그대로 넣어주면 알아서 세척해주고 있어 굉장히 편리한 세상이더라구요. 가장 중요한 건 세척력인 만큼, 표준으로 돌려보고 사용해본 결과 너무 만족스럽더라구요. 제가 일부러 하루 동안 먹은 것 중 짜장이 찌든것도 넣어보고 별걸 다 넣어봤는데, 그냥 뽀드득 소리가 날 정도로 굉장히 만족스럽게 세척이 되드라구요. 구석에 어디 하나 잔여물이 남지 않고 완벽하게 청소된 모습을 확인할 수 있었을 뿐만 아니라, 찌든 음식물 찌꺼기도 완벽하게 제거해 주더라구요. 세척이 덜 되었다 생각되는 유저라면 언제든지 강력모드로 전환해서 사용하시면 되구요. 세척 시간 역시 엄청 길지 않고, 알아서 세척 후 건조까지 해주는 만큼 더욱 뽀드득한 식기류를 경험할 수 있을 겁니다. 제품은 완벽 건조될 만큼 은 아니고 적당히 윤기 날 정도만 물기가 남고, 나머지는 마른 행주로 닦아주고 마무리 해주면 완벽 그 자체더라구요. 아 그리고 제품을 돌려보고 느꼈지만, 소음부분이 가장 인상적이었어요. 실제로 돌려보면서 34dB 정도가 맥시멈으로 나오면서 거의 정숙형 그 자체라 다른 일 하면서 제품을 사용해도 부담 전혀 없었구요. 영상을 보거나 독서를 함에 있어서도 전혀 부담이 없는 제품이지 않을 까 합니다. 최근 2인 가구 그리고 저처럼 1인가구가 많아지고 있는 시대인 만큼 이렇게 식세기가 컴팩트하게 나옴은 물론, 직수관 필요없이 하단 물탱크에 보충하는 방식은 신박하면서 많은 이들이 쉽게 접할 수 있게 해준 신세계 제품이지 않을 까 해요. 정리하자면 1. 제품은 색상도 오브제 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다.  10. 식세기 내부 세척 모드가 있어, 더욱 위생적인 관리 및 사용이 가능하다.

Sentence (English): Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. In the past, dishwashers were often bulky and unwieldy for single-person households. Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. 수 있을 겁니다. 제품은 완벽 건조될 만큼 은 아니고 적당히 윤기 날 정도만 물기가 남고, 나머지는 마른 행주로 닦아주고 마무리 해주면 완벽 그 자체더라구요. 아 그리고 제품을 돌려보고 느꼈지만, 소음부분이 가장 인상적이었어요. 실제로 돌려보면서 34dB 정도가 맥시멈으로 나오면서 거의 정숙형 그 자체라 다른 일 하면서 제품을 사용해도 부담 전혀 없었구요. 영상을 보거나 독서를 함에 있어서도 전혀 부담이 없는 제품이지 않을 까 합니다. 최근 2인 가구 그리고 저처럼 1인가구가 많아지고 있는 시대인 만큼 이렇게 식세기가 컴팩트하게 나옴은 물론, 직수관 필요없이 하단 물탱크에 보충하는 방식은 신박하면서 많은 이들이 쉽게 접할 수 있게 해준 신세계 제품이지 않을 까 해요. 정리하자면 1. 제품은 색상도 오브제 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다.  10. 식세기 내부 세척 모드가 있어, 더욱 위생적인 관리 및 사용이 가능하다.

Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다. Sentence (English): The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. In the past, dishwashers were often bulky and unwieldy for single-person households. Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

수 있을 겁니다. 제품은 완벽 건조될 만큼 은 아니고 적당히 윤기 날 정도만 물기가 남고, 나머지는 마른 행주로 닦아주고 마무리 해주면 완벽 그 자체더라구요. 아 그리고 제품을 돌려보고 느꼈지만, 소음부분이 가장 인상적이었어요. 실제로 돌려보면서 34dB 정도가 맥시멈으로 나오면서 거의 정숙형 그 자체라 다른 일 하면서 제품을 사용해도 부담 전혀 없었구요. 영상을 보거나 독서를 함에 있어서도 전혀 부담이 없는 제품이지 않을 까 합니다. 최근 2인 가구 그리고 저처럼 1인가구가 많아지고 있는 시대인 만큼 이렇게 식세기가 컴팩트하게 나옴은 물론, 직수관 필요없이 하단 물탱크에 보충하는 방식은 신박하면서 많은 이들이 쉽게 접할 수 있게 해준 신세계 제품이지 않을 까 해요. 정리하자면 1. 제품은 색상도 오브제 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다.  10. 식세기 내부 세척 모드가 있어, 더욱 위생적인 관리 및 사용이 가능하다.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. In the past, dishwashers were often bulky and unwieldy for single-person households. Perhaps because newlyweds and single- and two-person households are on the rise these days, the new Minix Pro Mini Dishwasher is a product that reflects this trend perfectly. I myself live alone in a three-room apartment, but my kitchen isn't that large. The Minix Mini Dishwasher is easy to install even in this small space. Furthermore, the product itself defies the conventional wisdom that dishwashers require a drain and water line. The product features an additional water tank at the bottom, allowing users like me who find it difficult to install a water line to use the dishwasher directly from the bottom. This is a groundbreaking innovation. The compact size might make it a bit awkward for a studio apartment, but it's perfectly suited for kitchens with two or more rooms, like mine. In addition to the gray color I chose, it also comes in a bright ivory color, allowing you to choose the color that best suits your kitchen decor. Moreover, the user manual provides detailed installation instructions, making it easy for anyone to install. Specifically, the illustrations clearly illustrate how to install the direct water pipe and how to supply water through the bottom water tank, making installation a breeze. The machine uses about 6 liters per cycle, and since it's self-filling, it comes with a large cup for easy refilling. As a single person, I can easily run it all day long, so a single refill is all it takes for a full day's worth of dishes. The washing mode offers standard, powerful, economical, and quick modes, allowing you to choose the right setting depending on how dirty your dishes are. The intuitive front display also shows the remaining time, allowing you to check the remaining time from a distance. Water supply is also easy, and these days, the dishwasher comes with a dedicated detergent cube that you simply add to the dishwasher and it cleans itself, which is incredibly convenient. Since cleaning power is paramount, I tried it on standard mode and was extremely satisfied. I deliberately added a bit of everything I'd eaten that day, including a bowl of black bean sauce, to the mix. It cleaned so well that it made a squeaking sound. Not only was it perfectly cleaned, leaving no residue in any corners, but it also thoroughly removed even stubborn food residue. If you feel it hasn't cleaned enough, you can switch to the Power mode at any time. The washing time isn't too long, and the dishwasher automatically washes and dries, leaving you with squeaky-clean dishes. The dishwasher isn't completely dry, but it's just moist enough to give it a nice sheen. Simply wipe the rest with a dry cloth and you're done. Oh, and the noise level was the most impressive thing I noticed when I was using it. It peaked at around 34dB, making it virtually silent, so I could use it while doing other things without any problems. I think it's also a product that won't be a problem while watching videos or reading. With the recent rise in two-person households and single-person households like mine, this compact dishwasher is a novel and accessible innovation, making it accessible to many. To summarize, 1. The color of the dishwasher is reminiscent of an object, creating a striking design. 2. The compact design allows for installation even in tight spaces. 3. Both self-filling and direct-filling modes are optional, allowing for use even without a water supply. 4. The dishwasher boasts excellent cleaning power, surpassing that of larger dishwashers. 5. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. The self-filling mode actually saves on electricity and water, as it only uses the specified amount of water. 7. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. The dishwasher has an internal cleaning mode, allowing for more hygienic management and use.

느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다. It offers a variety of cleaning modes and even features a drying fan after each wash, eliminating the need for air drying. 6. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. It is so quiet that anyone will be satisfied with its use. 9. It can clean a variety of dishes used in most households. 10. 느낌이라 디자인 효과를 낸다.  2. 제품 자체가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에서도 설치 가능하다.  3. 자가 급수 방식과 직수 방식 모두 선택적이라 급수관이 없을 시에도 사용이 가능하다,  4. 세척력이 우수해서, 대형 식세기 이상의 성능을 보여준다.  5. 세척 모드 다양함은 물론, 세척 이후 건조 팬 기능까지 갖추고 있어 매번 자연건조도 필요 없다.  6. 오히려 자가급수 방식이라 정해진 물만 사용하면 되기에 전기세도 아끼고 물도 아낌 7. 1-2인 가구에 최적화 된 만큼 내부 통은 많이는 아니지만 적당히 다 들어간다. 다만 후라이팬은 안들어감  8. 소음이 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙한 제품으로 누구나 사용해보면 만족 할 제품이다.  9. 대부분의 가정에서 사용하는 다양한 식기 모두 세척 가능하다. Optimized for one- to two-person households, the internal drum is spacious enough to accommodate a variety of items, though not a large one. However, it does not fit a frying pan. 8. Sentence (English): It's been about two months since I started using the Samsung Bespoke 6-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ How did I live without it? ] || ---------------- || It's been about two months since I started using the Samsung Bespoke 6-person dishwasher. At first, I wondered if I really needed a dishwasher, but now I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. Installation was easy because it was placed on top of the sink, and the clean design matches the kitchen atmosphere well. The tempered glass door also gives it a luxurious feel. It took some time to get used to loading dishes at first, but after running it a few times, I quickly got the hang of it. The cleaning power is better than I expected. It washes even greasy dishes and dishes with dried seasonings cleanly, so it feels much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. It washes with hot water and the door opens automatically at the end to remove moisture, so there's no smell and it dries well. Since it's for 6 people, running it once or twice a day is enough, and it's perfect for a family of 3. However, it's hard to put in large pots or frying pans at once, and they have to be washed separately, which is a bit disappointing. Still, it covers most of the dishes that come out in everyday life, so I'm overall satisfied. Above all, I feel like my quality of life has definitely improved because I can clean up the dishes right after every meal instead of having to pile them up. The time spent cooking and cleaning up has been reduced, and the biggest thing is that I am free from having to wash the dishes by hand. If you have the space, this is a product I would really recommend.

We liked the external towel bar (but keep reading. ) and hidden control features, but after using it a few months, maybe we should have gone with a different model (or even a different brand). The utensil baskets we received are much thinner and cheaper than the older model (I should have kept the old baskets! ). They also do not lock in securely, so whenever we removed the clean utensils, the baskets wanted to fall out and tip over. It felt extremely cheap. I looked on the Bosch USA website and they had a different utensil basket for sale. Then I looked at the parts list for my dishwasher, and it pointed to the same part. So why did we get something different? I called Bosch and they sent the new baskets to me (SMZ4000UC - for free, which was nice - thank you) and they are a million times better (like the old baskets). They are heavier, and most importantly -- they fit and don't fall over! So why did it ship with the cheaper baskets that don't even fit correctly? The dish racks feel lighter and thinner so unfortunately this one may not even last as long as the previous one, but only time will tell. The top and bottom rack both have a completely different layout (of prongs or tines) and it's been really difficult to get the dishes in like we want to. Sure, we were used to the other one for many years, but it was easy to fit the dishes in, and it held a lot, while not feeling like it was crowded. We've had several other dishwashers in the past and they were not arranged as well as the older model Bosch either, but this new one is the worst I've experienced. We can't get nearly the same amount of dishes into it as we could before. It's a victim of cost-reduction (cheapness) and poor design and engineering. Even though this dishwasher technically was supposed to be quieter than our old one (by 7 dB! -- 55 on the old vs 48dB on the new model), this new one is noticeably louder. How is that? It makes no sense, but it's true (and just in case you don't understand dB or decibels, an increase of 10dB means the sound is perceived as twice as loud [it's a logarithmic scale]! So 7dB lower should be significantly quieter than the old one, but instead it is the opposite). It does wash the dishes well. We pre-rinse our dishes and have been running the "speed wash" (60 minutes) because when running the "favorite" cycle, it took about 2.5 hours to complete. That was ridiculous. This is even after I tried to choose all of the power and time saving options in the "smart app". The "smart" app is not so smart, or maybe I'm not? The app does not even tell you what is going on when it is mid-cycle. Even though I really don't need the wifi connection (seriously, not everything in the house has to connect to the network, especially when that makes you more vulnerable to security holes and/or spying by corporations), I don't mind the notification on my phone, telling me when the cycle has completed, but I could certainly live without that (and have for my entire lifetime leading up to this point). In other words, I found one useful feature for the app and I could take it or leave it. Unfortunately, the first thing the dishwasher did when I connected it was download a new firmware update, so you almost have to connect it up, at least initially. I find it really disappointing that you can't access all of the exact same features from the front panel. some features are exclusive to the wifi app. Why? If I had realized that, I would not have purchased this model. I'm not anti-technology, I'm just not in support of, once again, poor engineering, where a manufacturer won't spend the money to fully develop the features (in this case so they can be accessed from the front panel). That's just cheapness. Or perhaps it's more devious and Bosch is forcing us to use their app so they can spy on consumers (and even if it's just gathering data about dishwashing cycles, that certainly feels unnecessary). That towel bar looked like a good idea, but we quickly realized that every time we open the dishwasher door, we have to remove the towel, otherwise it lays on the floor - so it's not as convenient as we thought it would be. I like the red LED that shines on the floor while the washer is running, but when the cycle is done, it just turns off. No indicator on the control panel either. I've seen other brands that use a multi-color LED (blue while running and green to show it's done and ready to be opened, etc. Smart! ). Once again, the cheapness and failure to completely engineer a feature on this model. This is certainly not the same Bosch I remember. What I do remember is that they charged a little more for a product that was superior, had more features, and higher quality. Apparently those days are gone.

Sentence (English): Purchase Date:Jun 17, 2025It has been non-stop with this dishwasher, but I finally believe it to be in working condition.
Comments (English): [ They lie about floor model conditions ] || ---------------- || Purchase Date:Jun 17, 2025It has been non-stop with this dishwasher, but I finally believe it to be in working condition. It said condition was good. It was not. It was not even fair.I spoke to a representative over the phone who had told me it was a floor model. I paid online and picked it up. I couldn't see the dishwasher as it was wrapped in bubble wrap, which is fine. I was told it was missing the box and manual.After an hour drive home, I started to install. First, I noticed it smelled like rotten cheese / milk. To my finding, there appeared to be a cottage cheese/vanilla milkshake or something spilled inside. So, either I was lied to, and this had been in someone's home, or someone dumped some kind of dairy product inside. I cleaned it thoroughly, but it still stunk. Turns out, it made its way down the drain line. Nothing but gray fuzzy MOLD. I took apart the drain and washed it out. It now smells fine. Hopefully, a couple of hot cycles will sanitize it. Now, I figured out it did not come with a water supply line. I was told the manual was the only item missing. I ran to Lowes, 20 min drive there by the way, 20 minutes back. Got the line, which was $20, and installed it. On to the electric, the wire harness going into the junction box on the front had a bad gash on the 120v cable. I had to trim it back and add new cabling to supply the box.Electric and water are fixed, hooked up, and powered on the unit. I noticed a bad humming sound and narrowed it down to the water pump. It was full of gunk. I cleaned it the best I could, but the motor is seized up. I ran back out to my local appliance store and grabbed a new water pump, which ran me $90.Now, this stinky, broken dishwasher is usable. And it works nicely. Something else to note, I wasn't aware of the dent on the front either.Had to order a utensil holder as well, they took it out. I'm an electrician by trade, and ran property maintenance for years, so I know how to work on these. I just spent around 4 hours, $110 in materials, gas money, and wear n tear on my vehicle to get this dishwasher up and running.It's too far a drive to make a return, plus actually maneuvering it. It's here for good. I do feel scammed. This is not at all what I was told I was getting.

Sentence (English): I had a dishwasher height/clearance issue because we had raised our kitchen floor after installing the prior dishwasher.
Comments (English): I had a dishwasher height/clearance issue because we had raised our kitchen floor after installing the prior dishwasher. This LG model stood out to me because it would fit the now smaller under counter opening. It had a very high score on Consumer Reports, pretty good specs, and a pretty good price, so I bought it. The Delivery guys were GREAT and it installs fairly easily: the new drain hose and power cord were already factory attached to it, so all I really had to do was swap out my old water feed hose and level it up (which went really well because of a cool mechanical design for the feet that can all be adjusted from the front). It is super quiet & easy to use (even for my wife "The Technology Hater") --and it gets the dishes clean! Drying is good too with the automatic (crack the) door feature. It has an LG factory Wi-Fi phone app, too, which looks good for troubleshooting (if I ever need it). Since this is a computer controlled device, I plugged it in through a UL single outlet surge suppressor unit ($15) to protect the control board (just in case) like I do with my microwave oven and HVAC system. (I'm tired of buying expensive control boards at $500 and up! ) Summary: YES, I'd buy this one again!

The Delivery guys were GREAT and it installs fairly easily: the new drain hose and power cord were already factory attached to it, so all I really had to do was swap out my old water feed hose and level it up (which went really well because of a cool mechanical design for the feet that can all be adjusted from the front). It is super quiet & easy to use (even for my wife 'The Technology Hater') --and it gets the dishes clean!! Drying is good too with the automatic (crack the) door feature. It has an LG factory Wi-Fi phone app, too, which looks good for troubleshooting (if I ever need it). Since this is a computer controlled device, I plugged it in through a UL single outlet surge suppressor unit ($15) to protect the control board (just in case) like I do with my microwave oven and HVAC system. (I'm tired of buying expensive control boards at $500 and up!!) Summary: YES, I'd buy this one again!

Sentence (English): We owned an older model of Bosch Dishwasher that we purchased around 2011.
Comments (English): [ Too many cost reductions = lower quality ] || ---------------- || We owned an older model of Bosch Dishwasher that we purchased around 2011. That one worked great until the racks eventually rusted through. We purchased this one (SHX4AEF5N) as a replacement. We liked the external towel bar (but keep reading. ) and hidden control features, but after using it a few months, maybe we should have gone with a different model (or even a different brand). The utensil baskets we received are much thinner and cheaper than the older model (I should have kept the old baskets! ). They also do not lock in securely, so whenever we removed the clean utensils, the baskets wanted to fall out and tip over. It felt extremely cheap. I looked on the Bosch USA website and they had a different utensil basket for sale. Then I looked at the parts list for my dishwasher, and it pointed to the same part. So why did we get something different? I called Bosch and they sent the new baskets to me (SMZ4000UC - for free, which was nice - thank you) and they are a million times better (like the old baskets). They are heavier, and most importantly -- they fit and don't fall over! So why did it ship with the cheaper baskets that don't even fit correctly? The dish racks feel lighter and thinner so unfortunately this one may not even last as long as the previous one, but only time will tell. The top and bottom rack both have a completely different layout (of prongs or tines) and it's been really difficult to get the dishes in like we want to. Sure, we were used to the other one for many years, but it was easy to fit the dishes in, and it held a lot, while not feeling like it was crowded. We've had several other dishwashers in the past and they were not arranged as well as the older model Bosch either, but this new one is the worst I've experienced. We can't get nearly the same amount of dishes into it as we could before. It's a victim of cost-reduction (cheapness) and poor design and engineering.Even though this dishwasher technically was supposed to be quieter than our old one (by 7 dB! -- 55 on the old vs 48dB on the new model), this new one is noticeably louder. How is that? It makes no sense, but it's true (and just in case you don't understand dB or decibels, an increase of 10dB means the sound is perceived as twice as loud [it's a logarithmic scale]! So 7dB lower should be significantly quieter than the old one, but instead it is the opposite). It does wash the dishes well. We pre-rinse our dishes and have been running the "speed wash" (60 minutes) because when running the "favorite" cycle, it took about 2.5 hours to complete. That was ridiculous. This is even after I tried to choose all of the power and time saving options in the "smart app". The "smart" app is not so smart, or maybe I'm not? The app does not even tell you what is going on when it is mid-cycle. Even though I really don't need the wifi connection (seriously, not everything in the house has to connect to the network, especially when that makes you more vulnerable to security holes and/or spying by corporations), I don't mind the notification on my phone, telling me when the cycle has completed, but I could certainly live without that (and have for my entire lifetime leading up to this point). In other words, I found one useful feature for the app and I could take it or leave it. Unfortunately, the first thing the dishwasher did when I connected it was download a new firmware update, so you almost have to connect it up, at least initially.I find it really disappointing that you can't access all of the exact same features from the front panel. some features are exclusive to the wifi app. Why? If I had realized that, I would not have purchased this model. I'm not anti-technology, I'm just not in support of, once again, poor engineering, where a manufacturer won't spend the money to fully develop the features (in this case so they can be accessed from the front panel). That's just cheapness. Or perhaps it's more devious and Bosch is forcing us to use their app so they can spy on consumers (and even if it's just gathering data about dishwashing cycles, that certainly feels unnecessary). That towel bar looked like a good idea, but we quickly realized that every time we open the dishwasher door, we have to remove the towel, otherwise it lays on the floor - so it's not as convenient as we thought it would be. I like the red LED that shines on the floor while the washer is running, but when the cycle is done, it just turns off. No indicator on the control panel either. I've seen other brands that use a multi-color LED (blue while running and green to show it's done and ready to be opened, etc. Smart! ). Once again, the cheapness and failure to completely engineer a feature on this model. This is certainly not the same Bosch I remember. What I do remember is that they charged a little more for a product that was superior, had more features, and higher quality. Apparently those days are gone.

We liked the external towel bar (but keep reading...) and hidden control features, but after using it a few months, maybe we should have gone with a different model (or even a different brand). They also do not lock in securely, so whenever we removed the clean utensils, the baskets wanted to fall out and tip over. It felt extremely cheap. I looked on the Bosch USA website and they had a different utensil basket for sale.  Then I looked at the parts list for my dishwasher, and it pointed to the same part. I called Bosch and they sent the new baskets to me (SMZ4000UC - for free, which was nice - thank you) and they are a million times better (like the old baskets). The dish racks feel lighter and thinner so unfortunately this one may not even last as long as the previous one, but only time will tell. The top and bottom rack both have a completely different layout (of prongs or tines) and it's been really difficult to get the dishes in like we want to. Sure, we were used to the other one for many years, but it was easy to fit the dishes in, and it held a lot, while not feeling like it was crowded.  We've had several other dishwashers in the past and they were not arranged as well as the older model Bosch either, but this new one is the worst I've experienced. So 7dB lower should be significantly quieter than the old one, but instead it is the opposite). It does wash the dishes well. Above all, the no-drill installation feature alone makes this appliance a true favorite among parents. Comments (English): [ Very unsatisfied ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher does a good job cleaning the dishes, but the door leaks and we have had for service appointments and none of them could rectify the problem. So how would you rate a dishwasher that always leaks from the door onto your hardwood floor! I would not recommend this dishwasher to anyone. Now I am informed that there is a service bulletin to fix the problem with my dishwasher. General Electric's remedy is to install a Seal Gasket Retainer to the defective area. To me, this is just a patch to hopefully stop the leak. This is not what I want or should except. This dishwasher was only three months old when the leak started. There were four service calls for this problem and now I am informed that there is a service recall. This service bulletin covers approximately 95 GE dishwashers. It appears to me that they have known about this problem for quite a while, and instead of performing a patchwork to hopefully fix the problem, these dishwashers should have been taken off the market and the ones already sold should be replaced or the total purchase price should be returned. Again, as stated before I would not recommend this dishwasher to anyone.
